description.value:
Lightning arcs from your hand as you attempt to touch a target with a melee tech attack, gaining advantage on the roll if the target is wearing metal armor or made of metal. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 lightning damage and is shocked until the start of its next turn.

This power's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
